## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] `make all` passes locally
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed
